'''Gift''' was the only surviving [[Gender/Legends|male]] son of two [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] members of the [[Community]], the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] clones produced on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Alongside nearly all of the other clones save for [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], he had begun suffering an illness once they left the moon for [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]. Gift succumbed to the sickness on [[Fhost]].<ref name="Riptide" />
